messages:
ashley (support): Customer 'PaperTrail' reporting SSO failures after IdP cert rotation around 09:12UTC. They see HTTP 403 'recipient mismatch' on ACS despite SAMLResponse present. Escalating.

devon (eng-sre): Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and the IdP metadata URL? Also include the Assertion Consumer URL seen in the SAMLResponse.

ashley (support): Repro curl and response below (redacted customer id). We hit /saml/acs and get 403.

ashley (support): ```bash
curl -v -X POST 'https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \n  --data-urlencode 'SAMLResponse=PHNhbWx...REDACTED...' \n  --data 'RelayState=client:session:xyz'
* Server returned 403
* Response body: {"error":"recipient mismatch"}
```

kevin (security): Two quick hypotheses: 1) IdP metadata change reordered KeyDescriptor/Signing elements and our metadata parser may be picking the wrong cert for signature validation. 2) ACS recipient in the assertion includes a query param or trailing slash that isn't canonicalized by our ACS whitelist. Both cause recipient mismatch.

devon (eng-sre): Ashley — what's the ACS value inside the Assertion (Issuer/Subject > Recipient)? If IdP posts ACS with `?session=` or with trailing slash we currently compare exact string.

ashley (support): From their SAMLResponse (decoded, sanitized):

ashley (support): ```xml
<Assertion ...>
  <SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs?session=abc123" NotOnOrAfter="2026-03-01T09:15:00Z" />
</Assertion>
```

ashley (support): Our configured ACS is `https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs` (no querystring).

devon (eng-sre): That matches hypothesis 2. The IdP is sending recipient with querystring. We should accept canonicalized ACS or reject at IdP. Short term: try our local metadata refresh and check metadata TTL / cached entity config.

devon (eng-sre): Running admin endpoint to reload metadata for this IdP: `POST /admin/identity-providers/{id}/reload-metadata` — can you run this on staging/prod?

ashley (support): I triggered a metadata reload for tenant papertrail-42 at 09:25UTC. No change, still 403. IdP metadata URL: https://idp.papertrail.example/metadata.xml (they rotated certs earlier this morning).

kevin (security): If they rotated certs, ensure our metadata watcher fetched the new cert chain. Check our cached IdP fingerprint vs the metadata fingerprint: `sha256:AA:BB:...`. Also check for duplicate KeyDescriptor entries — some vendors publish both old and new keys; ordering can matter for some parsers.

ashley (support): Fetch of metadata shows two KeyDescriptor entries. New cert present. Our poller log: `metadata/fetch 200 - checksum changed but applied after 5m delay`.

devon (eng-sre): The 5m delay could be from our metadata debounce. But that wouldn't cause recipient mismatch. We need to accept the ACS with query param. Quick test: can we simulate receiving the same SAMLResponse but with Recipient normalized? If we normalize by stripping query string, validation succeeds locally.

devon (eng-sre): Quick local repro snippet (python):

devon (eng-sre): ```py
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit

def normalize_recipient(url):
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    return urlunsplit((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, parts.path, '', ''))

print(normalize_recipient('https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs?session=abc123'))
# -> https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs
```

kevin (security): Good find. Short-term mitigation: add a small code path that accepts Recipient values if their normalized path matches an allowed ACS. This reduces blast radius vs disabling strict checks. But we should coordinate with product for policy.

ashley (support): Can we patch prod quickly? Customer is blocked. They said they can revert IdP change but prefer us to accept their current responses.

devon (eng-sre): I'll prepare a hotfix branch to normalize recipient comparison (strip query + default trailing slash handling). Will run canary in us-west first.

deploy-bot: Started canary deploy for release r-infer-2026.03.01-hotfix at 09:48UTC to us-west (5%).

devon (eng-sre): Canary passed on 5% after exercising SAML flows (manual replay). No regressions in signature validation. Rolling to 100% in 10m.

deploy-bot: Rolling deploy to 100% completed at 09:59UTC.

ashley (support): Customer verified login at 10:03UTC — SSO now works. They still see old cert in metadata cache on their side but assertions accepted.

kevin (security): Postmortem action items: 1) Add normalization for ACS recipient matching (already hotfixed). 2) Decrease metadata debounce/poll TTL for idp uploads to limit propagation window. 3) Add telemetry for "recipient mismatch" including sent vs accepted ACS to triage faster. 4) Test vector for KeyDescriptor ordering to ensure signature selection robust.

ashley (support): Noted. Customer asked for root cause summary: IdP rotated certs and updated metadata; in the rotation they also changed ACS formatting to include `?session=`. Our strict recipient equality check rejected assertions. Combined with metadata debounce, symptom surfaced during rotation window.

devon (eng-sre): I'll open a follow-up PR to add the telemetry + unit tests. Assigning to eng-sre and security to review.

kevin (security): Also suggest we add an admin utility to preview canonicalized ACS list for tenant configs and warn if IdP sends differing recipients.

ashley (support): Customer asked for timeline. Can we share the fix ETA and whether rollback needed?

devon (eng-sre): Fix deployed; no rollback needed. ETA: postmortem and follow-up PRs within 48h.

ashley (support): Thanks all — marking this resolved for the customer. :white_check_mark:

kevin (security): :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Incident tag updated: sso-recipient-normalization-7900001234, severity: low, status: mitigated.
